Q: How to calculate DATE Difference in PostgreSQL? A:

Extract did not work for me, so i found another way. I hope it will help

 (select firstDate::date - secondDate::date) as DateDifference

Q: I'm trying to remove duplicates in python, how can I make it work? A:

It needs to sort elements on list to convert ['n', 'e'] to ['e', 'n'], etc.

pair = list(sorted([i, j]))

batles.append(pair)

But you don't have to remove().
You can check if pair exists in batles before append().

pair = list(sorted([i, j]))

if pair not in batles:
   batles.append(pair)

And this will skip repeated elements.

You have to also check if i != j to skip ["tft","tft"], ["n","n"], ["e", "e"]

Full code:

players = ["tft", "n", "e"]
batles = []

for p1 in players:
    for p2 in players:
        if p1 != p2:  # skip ["tft","tft"], ["n","n"], ["e", "e"]
            pair = list(sorted([p1, p2]))
            if pair not in batles:
                batles.append(pair)

batles.sort()
print(batles)

Q: How to remove highlight from entry in pygtk? A:

Adding grab_focus_without_selecting() after setting text removed the highlighting.

my_entry.grab_focus_without_selecting()

Q: Using custom number formatting "#,##0.00" and "#.##0,00" in VBA produces unwanted results A:

Please, try the next way, which should work for both cases (Decimal and Thousands separators):

   Dim rng As Range
   Set rng = ActiveSheet.ListObjects(1).DataBodyRange
   rng.NumberFormat = Format("#,###.00", "Standard")

Please, send some feedback after testing it

Q: How to store the machine learning model pickle to azure blob and retrieve it/ A:

Based on my understanding, you just want to upload your picfile which names finalized_model.sav to Azure Storage.

Then I would suggest you use azure-storage-blob SDK to upload a blob. Here is an official sample: Code examples.

In details, firstly you need to get the connection string of your storage account from portal, then you create a BlobServiceClient with the connection string, after that you can create a container client by blob_service_client.create_container(container_name). Finally, you can create a blob client and then upload the local file based on its path.

And it is also easy to download it back from Azure Storage. The sample for downloading blobs:

with open(download_file_path, "wb") as download_file:
    download_file.write(blob_client.download_blob().readall())

Q: jenkins cannot read from remote repository A:

On all Jenkins nodes where this would be probably running (that is all including the master if it has some executors configured) you'll need to make sure to have a working ssh configuration.

In particular it tells you that there's some issue with the host key verification. Logon to that machine and check whether. While playing around on that machine you may use ssh git@git.rocketsoftware.com:7999 to see whether you fixed the issue.

  • Any possible existing host key probably needs an update
  • Strict host key checking is enabled (in ~/.ssh/config) but there's no host key given in ~/.ssh/known_hosts

Q: Path to the GWT Installation Directory A:

Download GWT SDK manually from http://www.gwtproject.org/download.html, .. unzip it ... you'll fine "gwt-user.jar" there

In Eclipse, open Window | Preferences | Google | Web Toolkit .. click "Add" then browse to this unzipped folder.

You do not need GWT turned on in order to create a New Web Application Project. If you do not want to use GWT just uncheck the "Use Google Web Toolkit" checkbox on that same dialog and it should work.
